dataset: RAVDESS / external acted emotional speech / video-only / actors 01-04
protocol: Ten evenly spaced frames in middle 60% of each clip; mean probabilities after face/quality checks; clip-level labels

full_eight_output_metrics.independence_note: Use actor-bootstrap intervals as primary. Wilson intervals assume independent clips and are diagnostic only; four actors are insufficient for population claims.

seven_class_renormalized_diagnostic.independence_note: Use actor-bootstrap intervals as primary. Wilson intervals assume independent clips and are diagnostic only; four actors are insufficient for population claims.

limitations: Acted clip-level categories are not frame ground truth or gamer mood
Only four actors; actor-bootstrap intervals are unstable and do not demonstrate population validity
Image-calibrated confidence is evaluated without tuning on this video set
The seven-class diagnostic renormalizes scores; it is not the operational deployed classifier
FER+ identity IDs are unavailable; disjoint recordings do not prove disjoint people
